tex_content.html: For $\tau _1=\varepsilon r^2$, there is $\varepsilon _0=\varepsilon _0(\bar\tau _0)>0$ such that $\varepsilon \leq \varepsilon _0$ implies \[ \int _{\widetilde W_{\mathrm{sm}}} \tau _1^{-n/2}e^{-\widetilde l(Z,\tau _1)} {\mathcal J}(Z,\tau _1)\, dZ \leq 2\varepsilon ^{n/2}. \]
